build_command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; from kernelbench.kernel_static_checker import validate_kernel_static; src = Path('solution.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); ok, errors, warnings = validate_kernel_static(src, backend='cuda', precision='fp32'); print(errors) if errors else None; print(warnings) if warnings else None; raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)"
test_command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; from kernelbench.eval import eval_kernel_against_ref, get_torch_dtype_from_string; from kernelbench.utils import set_gpu_arch; set_gpu_arch(['Blackwell']); problem = Path('problem.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); solution = Path('solution.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); result = eval_kernel_against_ref(original_model_src=problem, custom_model_src=solution, verbose=False, measure_performance=False, timing_method='cuda_event', num_correct_trials=5, num_perf_trials=1, backend='cuda', precision=get_torch_dtype_from_string('fp32')); print(result); raise SystemExit(0 if (result and result.compiled and result.correctness) else 1)"
